newsitem.title: UK: PHYTOPHARM IN S.AFRICA ANTI-FAT DRUG PACT.
newsitem.headline: PHYTOPHARM IN S.AFRICA ANTI-FAT DRUG PACT.

text.p: British medicine firm Phytopharm Plc said on Monday it planned to develop a natural anti-obesity product from a medicinal plant found in South Africa.
The company said it would develop the drug in a deal with South Africa's statutory scientific research council, the CSIR.
A spokeswoman said the company did not disclose the plant's name to protect its intellectual property.
Phytopharm said it would also collaborate on the development of botanical medicines from the CSIR's ethno-botanical screening programme.
The programme will work with South Africa's traditional medical practitioners to find new medicines from indigenous plants.
The company's shares were marked up 1.5p at 136.5 by 0735 GMT.
